name: ~Koidamazume~
source:
This is a fan disc of Step x Steady, featuring lovelove H scenes with heroines. The game includes a new story of Miyako and additional scenarios of other heroines. Also, Sunao from Harumoi appears.

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
这是《Step×Steady》的Fan Disc，收录了女主角们甜蜜恩爱的H场景。游戏包含都的新故事、其他女主角的追加剧情，以及《春萌》中素直的登场。

[摘自ErogeShop]
